title: Continuity of Care and Coverage Change Terms by Review Package
content:
For new members and for changes in coverage, the Utilization Management Program applies the following package terms.

## New-member continuity of care

| Review package | Window for granting a continuity-of-care approval (calendar days from the review program effective date, that date as day 1) | Prior-carrier claims history for the drug needed in addition to the prior carrier's approval letter | Days a continuity-of-care approval runs from the review program effective date (that date as day 1) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 90 | No | 90 |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 90 | No | 90 |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 90 | Yes | 90 |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 60 | Yes | 60 |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 60 | Yes | 60 |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 60 | Yes | 60 |

## Coverage changes (all six packages)

| Term | Every package |
|---|---|
| Approvals in force carry over when the sponsor changes the review package | Yes |
| Approvals end on the last day of plan coverage and resume through their original expiration date on COBRA reinstatement | Yes |

*Hypothetical illustration of the day count:* with a review program effective on 1 March, day 1 is 1 March, 31 March is day 31, so on a 60-day package day 60 is 29 April and on a 90-day package day 90 is 29 May. A continuity-of-care approval on a 60-day package therefore runs through 29 April.
